title: Open Coffee translations
description: Translated text fields for one dataset file, keyed by record id. Untranslated records fall back to the base file.

$schema.description: Canonical URL of the schema version this file follows.

locale.description: Language of the translations, as a code such as de or de-AT.

base.description: Path of the base dataset file, for example datasets/coffee-places/de/munich.json.

meta.description: Information about the file: dataset version, generation time, licence, language and the base file it translates.

name.description: The record's name in this language, only when it is really used locally.

description.description: Translation of the record's description into this language.

additionalProperties.description: Translated texts for one record. Fields left out fall back to the base file.

entries.description: Translations keyed by the record id they belong to, for example cp-7k2m9x4qvd.
